# Website dependencies

- GSAP and ScrollTrigger **3.15.0**, from the official `gsap` npm package. Original copyright and licence notices remain in the files. [GSAP standard licence](https://gsap.com/standard-license/).
- Lenis **1.3.27**, from the official `lenis` npm package. MIT licence included as `LENIS-LICENSE.txt`.

These files are hosted locally with the website; no runtime CDN request is needed.

The PlayCover logo in `../assets/playcover-logo.png` is the original asset from [PlayCover's repository](https://github.com/PlayCover/PlayCover/blob/develop/images/logo.png). It identifies compatibility with PlayCover; this bridge is an independent community project.
